name: feature-announcement
title: Feature announcement
summary: A 20-to-90-second film that announces one new feature: what's new, why it matters, how it works in the real product, and who gets it when.
use_when: A feature has shipped (or ships on a known date) and existing users and prospects should know.

beats.name: what's new
beats.job: Name the feature in the first three seconds.

beats.name: why it matters
beats.job: The problem it solves, in the user's words.

beats.name: how it works
beats.job: One or two steps in the real product.

beats.name: availability
beats.job: Who gets it, when and where, and the one next step.

rules: Show it working in the real product (slate capture); never a mock-up of something that doesn't ship.

capture.source: slate capture ios or slate capture web
capture.principle: Capture for truth and speed; rebuild in code when a shot needs camera moves, restaging, motion blur or exact type.

captions.position: inside the channel's safe zone for the aspect
captions.note: Square and vertical cuts use shorter lines (36 and 32 characters).

budget.note: The reel-or-ad row. A 90-second announcement still fits: at the pace ceiling that's about 234 words of voice-over, and about 1,250 credits of score at the roughly 825 credits a minute the films measured.
